introTitle: Resize video for free, right in your browser
introP1: AspectCut lets you resize video online without installing an app or sending your file to a server. Pick a platform size or enter your own ratio, choose how the video should fill the new frame, and download the finished file. There is no account to create and no watermark on the result.
introP2: Because the video resize happens on your own device, your clip stays private and there is no upload to wait for. Speed depends on your device and the length of the clip. This video resize online tool works in desktop and mobile browsers that support WebCodecs.
sizesTitle: Resize video for every platform and screen
sizesSubtitle: Select a size to load it into the video resizer.
featuresTitle: Everything you need to resize video online

features.title: Resize for any platform
features.text: Resize video for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Pinterest, WhatsApp and common screens, at exact pixels.

features.title: Blur, crop or bars
features.text: Fill the new frame with a blurred background, crop to fit, or add bars in any color.

features.title: Zoom and reframe
features.text: Drag the crosshair and zoom up to 300% to keep your subject in the shot after you resize.

features.title: Custom sizes
features.text: Enter any ratio up to 4:1, including decimals such as 2.35:1.

features.title: No upload
features.text: Your video is resized inside your browser and is never uploaded to a server.

features.title: Free, no watermark
features.text: Resize video online with no account and no watermark on the exported file.

features.title: MP4 and WebM export
features.text: Open MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV up to 500 MB, then export H.264 MP4 or VP9 WebM.

features.title: Sound stays in
features.text: Your audio track is carried into the resized file automatically.

howTitle: How to resize a video online

steps.title: Add your video
steps.text: Choose or drop the video you want to resize. It stays on your device.

steps.title: Pick a size
steps.text: Choose a platform, a screen size, or a custom ratio, then frame the shot.

steps.title: Resize and download
steps.text: Your browser resizes the video, then the file is ready to save.

whyP1: Every platform expects a different shape. A widescreen clip made for YouTube looks small on TikTok, and a vertical phone recording leaves wide empty sides in a 16:9 player. When you resize video to the right dimensions, it fills the screen and your subject stays easy to see.
whyLead: People most often use a video resize tool to:
whyItems: Turn a 16:9 video into a 9:16 Reel, Short or TikTok at 1080×1920
Make a 4:5 or 1:1 version for the Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn feed
Fit a vertical clip into a 16:9 frame for YouTube or a presentation
Scale a large video down to 1080p or 720p
tipsTitle: Tips to resize video without losing the shot

tips.text: Each export re-encodes the video, so a copy that has already been compressed will lose more detail.

tips.lead: Match the method to the clip.
tips.text: Use blur when nothing can be cut, crop when the subject is easy to frame, and bars when you want a solid color.

tips.lead: Keep faces and text near the center.
tips.text: Buttons and captions often cover the edges of vertical videos on social apps.
You can resize a 720p clip to 4K, but it will only be larger, not sharper.
Choose a lower resolution or lower the quality setting before you export.
